title: Duet run configurations
description: A project's .duet/run.json: the commands it is built, run, debugged and tested with, each run by the system's shell in a terminal tab.

configurations.description: The project's run configurations. One named like a configuration Duet detects in the build files replaces it.

configuration.description: A command the project is built, run, debugged or tested with. Duet skips one without a name or a command.

name.description: Its name in the Run menu and its terminal's title.

kind.description: What it does: Build, Run, Debug and Test run the first configuration of their kind. "run" when it is not given.

command.description: A shell command line, e.g. "cmake --build build".

folder.description: The folder it runs in, relative to the project; its root when it is empty or not given.

env.description: Variables added to the editor's environment.
